modules.title: Traffic Vision
modules.description: Training to recognize traffic situations early and react correctly. Focus on sensorimotor skills and methods for successful driver training.

modules.title: Traffic Environment
modules.description: Adapting speed to the current situation. Using 360-degree videos from Zug to teach appropriate driving behavior. Assessing pedestrians, roads, and visibility conditions.

modules.title: Traffic Dynamics
modules.description: Basic rules of driving physics. Covering electronic assistance systems and vehicle maintenance (using Tesla and combustion engines as examples).

modules.title: Traffic Tactics
modules.description: Strategies for safe driving. Examining the influence of fatigue, distraction, drugs, and medication. Risk prevention is the priority.

faq.question: When should I attend the traffic theory course?
faq.answer: Under the 2026 rules, you can attend after passing theory and receiving your learner’s permit. Under the new rules from January 2027, take the VKU before the basic theory test.

faq.question: What is traffic theory instruction?
faq.answer: Traffic theory is an in-person course on recognising hazards, anticipating the actions of others and adjusting your speed, space and attention.

faq.question: When must I attend the VKU?
faq.answer: The complete course is part of first-time training for categories A, A1, B and B1. If you passed basic theory before 2027, you need proof before the practical test.

faq.question: How long does the VKU take?
faq.answer: Eight hours in total. The 2026 Zug groups run on two days. From 2027 the four sessions take place on four separate days.

faq.question: How much does a VKU cost?
faq.answer: The advertised 2026 Zug course costs CHF 230 for the whole group of sessions, including materials, attendance confirmation, drinks and fruit. Check the group price before booking.

faq.question: How long is the traffic theory valid?
faq.answer: Forever. A completed VKU remains valid indefinitely.

faq.question: What do I need to bring to the VKU?
faq.answer: For a 2026 course, bring your learner’s permit and a charged phone. Writing supplies, materials and drinks are available. For 2027, check the FABER PIN requirements in your confirmation.

faq.question: Is the Zug course taught in English?
faq.answer: Check the teaching-language filter on the dates page. When no English group is available in Zug, you can compare English groups in Zurich or view the German groups here.

faq.question: How do I change a booking?
faq.answer: DriveLab allows free changes or cancellation up to six days before the course. Section 6 of the provider’s terms covers later changes.
